summary.text: Cody Maynard was elected in 2022 to represent District 21 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives, which includes parts of Bryan and Marshall Counties. He is a licensed certified public accountant and serves on the House Appropriations and Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Maynard holds a BBA in Accounting and Finance and a Master of Accountancy from Abilene Christian University, and became a licensed CPA in 2012.
His House biography cites over 15 years of experience in accounting and financial management.
He serves on the Lead Team for Legacy Christian School, is a member of the Durant Area Chamber of Commerce, and helped launch Trail Life Troop 2911, where he serves as treasurer.
He lives in Durant with his wife and their three children.
